items.title: From the Trenches: My Path Through Postgres
items.blurb: From Oracle defender to Postgres zealot: one engineer's 20-year journey through VACUUM bugs, 35k TPS trading systems, HA stacks, and how PG Phriday was born.

items.title: Fix Circular Role Dependencies Before Upgrading RDS and Aurora Postgres
items.blurb: Circular role dependencies can stall or roll back a major version upgrade of Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL or Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL when you move from PostgreSQL 14 or earlier to 15 or later.

items.title: Postgres Calculations and the Ambiguity of NULL
items.blurb: How Postgres evaluates calculations when a value is unknown: three-valued logic, arithmetic and concatenation with NULL, NOT IN, aggregates and window functions, NULL sort order, and Postgres 19 IGNORE NULLS.

items.title: Kafgres: A Kafka-Compatible Broker Embedded Inside Postgres
items.blurb: Embedding a performant singleton Kafka broker into Postgres.

items.title: chdb: An Extension for Fast Imports from S3, GCS and Azure
items.blurb: The chdb Postgres extension brings fast imports and exports across cloud storage platforms and data formats, powered by the embedded ClickHouse engine.
